sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:19

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:19:1
items.html:
He began to sort from them the sparks and the vessels as well: That is to say, apart from sorting the lights of BON, which are the records, he also sorts the sparks and the vessels; for through his sorting of the lights of the records, the vessels too are found receiving their correction, since the records correct and raise to themselves the vessels that belong to them.
And the matter of this sorting means that he bestows upon them from his illumination, as above in the adjacent item, where the Rosh of the ten Sefirot of the new MA, which came out through the upper coupling of AB and SAG, clothed in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, and they receive the level of Keter from it. And this is regarded as the new MA having sorted the GAR of Nekudim and corrected them to be a discernment of Nukva to it, that is, to receive its bestowal from it. And the reason it is called by the term “sorting” is that every degree of the new MA sorted precisely those parts of BON that belong to its degree. For all the records of BON, from the GAR and from the ZAT, rose as MAN all at once, as above (page 609, the passage beginning “And the reason”), and the new MA sorted them slowly, one after the other, that is, according to the revelation of its own degrees. For when the Atik of MA was emanated, it sorted the most select of the whole of the MAN, namely the GAR of Nekudim, and joined them to itself as the discernment of the Nukva of Atik. And afterwards, when the AA of MA was emanated, it sorted the part belonging to its degree and joined it to itself as its own discernment of Nukva, and so forth in like manner. And therefore this is called by the name “sortings.”

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:19:2
items.html: The Nukva in all the Partzufim: For all the males were made from the new MA, and all the females were made from the lights and the sparks and the vessels that remained of Nekudim after the breaking of the vessels. Indeed, in AVI and ZON there is an inclusion of BON in the males as well, and likewise an inclusion of MA in the females as well. And it will be explained in its place. The aforementioned Ibur of the upper one began to sort the most select of them all: For the beginning of the sortings is at the time of the first coupling of the ascent of the MAN to the forehead of SAG, which took place in the Rosh of SAG itself, when only the level of Malchut came out, as above (page 608, the passage beginning “Ibur”). And as soon as this level and the Ibur of the new MA came out, it immediately sorted for itself, out of the whole of the MAN of BON, the lights, and also the sparks and the vessels belonging to it in that same quantity and quality of the discernments of the Ibur; and they were raised from BYA to Atzilut and were corrected there in the discernment of three within three. And it has already been explained that the level of the Ibur is the three Sefirot NHY, and that they clothe in the three upper vessels KHB, by reason of the inverse relation between vessels and lights, as above (page 609, the passage beginning “And already”). Accordingly it turns out that what was sorted now and rose from BYA through the level of the Ibur was only the select upper vessels among the vessels and the sparks that had fallen to BYA, namely the vessels of KHB. And this is what he says: “At first, through the Ibur of the upper one, he began to sort the most select of them all.”

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:19:3
items.html: And from it the Nukva of Atik was made: He means the ZAT of the Nukva of Atik; but the GAR of the Nukva of Atik were not sorted even in the least from the sparks and the vessels of BYA. Rather, she was made from the GAR of Nekudim, from those discernments that the breaking did not touch at all.
